bio.text: Scott Morgan is the United Kansas Party candidate for Kansas Secretary of State in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Morgan is an attorney and the executive director of United Kansas, and co-founded the Free State Party, which merged with the United Kansas Party in April 2026.
Morgan has worked for former Gov. Mike Hayden and U.S. Sens. Nancy Landon Kassebaum and Bob Dole, and served two terms on the Lawrence school board.

sources.title: Who's running for Kansas secretary of state in 2026? Here's a guide
